outcome: Gestational age at first prenatal visit
cohort: 413 women who traveled for obstetric care and delivered at Stroger Hospital in Chicago, IL
finding: Reproductive travelers had better obstetric outcomes and fewer NICU admissions compared to non-travelers delivering at the same institution.
mod_finding: 28.6% of reproductive travelers had cesarean delivery, with prior uterine surgery being the most common indication.
gest_age: Median gestational age at first prenatal visit: 35 weeks
